title: Personnel.
officialText:
An approved agency shall employ experienced personnel qualified to conduct, supervise and evaluate the
tests or inspections that it undertakes. Special inspections may be performed only by employees of such agency who are special
inspectors qualified pursuant to department rules to perform or witness the particular test or inspection. The commissioner may
require proof of the qualifications of employees.
